title: pkix-chain LeafIdent and NoCheckShim missing Debug/Clone
description:
In pkix-chain/src/lib.rs:1439-1503, the internal types LeafIdent and NoCheckShim do not derive Debug or Clone. While they are private types, the coding standard says 'put a doc comment on everything that rustdoc knows how to document' and 'derive liberally: Debug on almost everything.'

What goes wrong: If a future maintainer needs to debug the OCSP-nocheck bypass logic, they cannot inspect these types in a debugger or log. The missing derives make refactoring harder.

Locations:
- pkix-chain/src/lib.rs:1439 (LeafIdent)
- pkix-chain/src/lib.rs:1470 (NoCheckShim)

Recommendation: Add #[derive(Debug)] to both. Clone is also natural for LeafIdent since it holds only borrowed references.
